info.title: Cairn API
info.description:
Cairn walks a family through the logistics of a death, one step at a time.

Every response that moves a conversation forward carries a `next_step` with a
single prompt, so clients can ask one question at a time. Errors use RFC 9457
problem details (`application/problem+json`) and never echo submitted values.

Authentication is an Auth0 access token. Accounts can be created with Google,
Apple, or an email magic link (see GET /v1/welcome). Onboarding follows
UC-REG-01 to UC-REG-14, one question per screen. Case creation follows
UC-CASE-01 to UC-CASE-18: a case starts as a draft, and the free period of 28
days starts only when the user taps Start journey on their first case. After
it ends the account is read-only until subscribed. No payment information is
asked for anywhere in case creation. Free text is redacted as it is received
and never stored. The case is the security boundary and is enforced in the
database with row-level security.

get.description: UC-REG-01. Acknowledgment first, then three equally weighted ways to continue, a sign-in link, and a link to the public journey map. Asks for nothing. After a cancelled Google or Apple sign-in, call with oauth_cancelled=true to add the reassurance note (UC-REG-02, UC-REG-03).

get.summary: Ways to create an account or sign in
get.description: Google, Apple, or email (a passwordless magic link by default). Each option names the Auth0 connection the client passes to Auth0's /authorize endpoint. No sign-in is needed to call this.

post.summary: Create the account, or sign in and resume onboarding
post.description: UC-REG-02 to UC-REG-05 and UC-REG-13. Call after every Auth0 sign-in. Auth0 has already verified the Google or Apple identity token, or the email magic link, and this API verifies Auth0's signed token. Email and sign-in method come from the token, never from the body. A new account starts in pending_onboarding and the response is the Privacy Policy and Terms acknowledgment. There is no age question. A returning user gets 200 and the first incomplete step, with a welcome-back note.

200.description: Account already existed. Resumes at the first incomplete step.

403.description: Email not yet confirmed, or an unsupported sign-in method.

409.description: This email already has an account created another way (UC-REG-05). sign_in_method names it and next_step offers it as the primary button.

get.summary: Where the user is in onboarding
get.description: UC-REG-13. Returns the first incomplete step, or a changed acknowledgment to re-read.

post.summary: Agree to, or say "I'm not sure" about, an acknowledgment
post.description: UC-REG-07 (privacy_terms), UC-REG-08 (trial_terms), UC-REG-09 (ai_notice), and UC-REG-10. Agreeing requires the document_version shown with the checkbox and appends a consent record with the version, time, sign-in method, and client. agreed=false records nothing and offers ways forward. Also used to re-acknowledge a changed version (UC-REG-13). The trial clock does not start here.

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

422.description: document_version isn't the current one. Show the screen again.

put.summary: Save what Cairn should call the user
put.description: UC-REG-11. A name pre-filled from Google or Apple is only saved when the user sends it here. Legal names are not collected. If the text shows signs of distress, nothing is saved and sign-up pauses (UC-REG-14).

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

put.summary: Choose how Cairn talks with the user
put.description: UC-REG-12. Saves the chosen voice on the account. choose_for_me selects the default voice. The voice changes tone only, never the crisis protocol, AI disclosure, attorney referrals, or citations. Finishes onboarding (status active_no_case) and hands off to case creation with a confirmation in the chosen voice.

409.description: An earlier step isn't finished yet. next_step says which one.

get.description: UC-REG-14. Stops the task flow. Returns an acknowledgment and the 988 resource, and nothing else. Nothing is stored, no timers or reminders are set, and progress already saved stays saved. No sign-in needed, so it works from the welcome screen too. The same for every voice.

post.description: After UC-REG-12. The relationship shapes the wording of case creation. A power of attorney is told that authority generally ends at death. Not stored here. Send user_role to POST /v1/cases to save it.

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or an acknowledgment changed.

get.description: Includes the effective status (read_only after the trial), the trial end date in the account's time zone, the AI guide label, and any banner or reminder to show.

patch.description: Preferred name, pronunciation, voice, and time zone. The voice changes tone only. It never changes the crisis protocol, AI disclosure, referrals, or citations.

get.description: UC-ACCT-01 steps 1 and 2. Explain plainly, then ask for confirmation.

post.summary: Delete the account and personal data
post.description: UC-ACCT-01. Deletes the account, its consents and reminders, and every case it created, now, in one transaction. This is deletion, not deactivation. The Auth0 user is deleted, and Apple tokens are revoked through the Sign in with Apple REST API, by a job that works through the queue this adds to. Works in every status, including read-only.

UC-CASE-01 and UC-CASE-18. Creates a draft case right away and acknowledges the loss before asking anything. Offers two ways in: one question at a time, or in your own words. Creating or editing a draft never starts the free period (DEC-01). A read-only account can create a draft. Nothing about the person who died is collected here.

403.description: Not a member of this case, the case does not exist, or (for an active case) the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

get.description: UC-CASE-10. Opening a draft counts as activity and resets its 28 days. The response greets the user, says in one line where they left off, and asks whether to continue.

403.description: Not a member of this case, the case does not exist, or (for an active case) the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: Onboarding isn't finished, or a changed acknowledgment needs to be agreed to.

patch.summary: Record the deceased's legal identity, inside the task that needs it
patch.description: Just in time only. full_legal_name and date_of_birth are never part of case creation (never_collect_at_case_creation). Refused while the case is a draft. The database refuses it too.

403.description: Not a member of this case, the case does not exist, or (for an active case) the account is read-only (code account_read_only).

409.description: The case is still a draft.

put.summary: Answer, skip, or say I'm not sure
put.description: UC-CASE-02 to UC-CASE-09. Saves one data_fields answer with its answer_state (answered, skipped, unsure). A question with any answer is not asked again. Changing an answer recomputes the journey and says what changed in one line. On an active case it adds or sets aside add-on tasks without touching progress on other tasks.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.summary: Say something in your own words
post.description: UC-CASE-01 own words, UC-CASE-05, UC-CASE-07, UC-CASE-10, UC-CASE-14 to UC-CASE-17. The text is redacted as it is received and never stored. Cairn reads back only the data_fields it found and asks Did I get that right? Nothing is saved until the user confirms. Signs of distress stop the questions.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.description: UC-CASE-01 own words. Saves the confirmed values. Only data_fields keys are accepted, each checked like a button answer, so nothing else from the free text can be stored. Then asks only about fields still missing.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.description: The user asked to continue: after choosing one question at a time, after resuming, or after stepping away during distress (UC-CASE-14). Returns the next question still missing.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.description: UC-CASE-10. Everything is already saved with each answer. This records where the user left off and confirms it plainly, including that an untouched draft is deleted after 28 days. Pausing never starts the free period, and no reminder about the draft is sent.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

put.summary: Choose a shorter pace, or what to call them when there's no name
put.description: UC-CASE-02 (professional fiduciary pace) and UC-CASE-03 (name fallback).

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.summary: The death has not happened yet
post.description: UC-CASE-17. not_yet records it, explains that journeys start after a death, and offers to save a draft or come back later. Start journey is not offered and the free period does not start. save_draft confirms the draft and its 28-day deletion. has_happened clears it. The pre-need path is not built (OPEN-DECISION-05).

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

post.summary: Something Cairn should not guide alone
post.description: UC-CASE-16 and UC-CASE-07. Records the reason and adds Talk to an estate attorney as a task, with the attorney referral line. The journey is never blocked. Cairn keeps showing every step it can help with. A death outside the US and a state with no verified content are handled from the answers.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

get.description: UC-CASE-11. Two groups: what you told me, and what we can figure out later. Each line has Edit. The user's own words are shown where free text was given, except for how it happened, which shows the choice's label.

403.description: Not the owner of this case, the case does not exist, or an active case on a read-only account.

get.description: UC-CASE-12. Runs journey selection on the answers so far and explains in a sentence or two why the journey fits. Shows the first four weeks by week: done items checked, open items labeled When you're ready. Missing answers never block it. Shows the pre-button notice, then Start journey and Not yet. Viewing it never starts the free period.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.description: UC-CASE-12 and UC-CASE-18. In one transaction: the case becomes active, the journey template key and version are pinned, journey_started_at is set, the tasks are created, and on the account's first journey the 28-day free period starts (DEC-01). A second journey never restarts or extends it (DEC-04). No payment information is asked for or stored (DEC-02). Send back the pre-button notice version to show the notice was on screen first. A read-only account gets a subscription prompt.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

409.description: Already started, the death hasn't happened, or the notice changed since it was shown.

post.description: UC-CASE-12. The case stays a draft, the free period doesn't start, and everything is saved.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.summary: Choose what feels doable right now
post.description: UC-CASE-13. A task id opens that task (any task, without comment), small_task offers the small thing, and not_today leaves the case active with no task in progress. Cairn never starts a task the user didn't choose.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: The journey, with one next action in front
get.description: UC-9 and UC-12. While paused, a calm check-in and no task list. A draft points to the preview.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.summary: Step back from tasks for a while
post.description: UC-12. Holds all progress exactly as it is. Stores only the time the pause ends. No reason or feeling is collected or stored.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

post.description: UC-12. Returns the journey with the same single next action as before the pause.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: Everything done, in progress, and next, in one view
get.description: UC-13. Grouped by certificates, agencies, financial institutions, and other areas.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the case does not exist.

get.summary: Open a task with its guidance and sources
get.description: Guidance, citations to the issuing authority, and anything already recorded for it.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

patch.summary: Change a task's status or snooze it
patch.description: Setting status to done records the completion time. The response carries the next action.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

post.description: UC-10. Saves copies and expected arrival, marks the task done, and returns the next task.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

409.description: This task is not the death certificate task.

post.summary: Record that an institution was notified
post.description: UC-11. Records the institution as notified and, by default, marks the task done so the journey moves on. Sending the same institution name again updates that entry.

403.description: Not a member of this case, not an owner, or the task does not exist.

409.description: This task is not an institution notification task.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. Sent only after the user confirms.

voice.description: The voice chosen in onboarding or Settings. Tone only.

status.description: Effective status. read_only once the trial has ended.

trial_end_date.title: Trial End Date
trial_end_date.description: trial_ends_at as a date in the account's time zone.

ai_label.title: Ai Label
ai_label.description: Show in every chat view once set.

AccountPatch.title: AccountPatch
AccountPatch.description: Settings. The voice can be changed at any time. Omitted fields are unchanged.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: The read-only banner or a due trial reminder, when there is one.

client.title: Client
client.description: App platform and version, stored on the consent record.

AcknowledgmentIn.title: AcknowledgmentIn
AcknowledgmentIn.description: agreed=false is the "I'm not sure" path (UC-REG-10). Nothing is recorded for it.

value.title: Value
value.description: Required when state is answered. Its shape depends on the field. See FIELD_VALUE_TYPES.

own_words.title: Own Words
own_words.description: The user's words for this answer, shown on the review screen. Never for circumstance.

away_from_home.title: Away From Home
away_from_home.description: place_of_death only. The death happened away from home, so residence_state is asked next.

AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn
AnswerIn.description: Answer one question by button or form. Every question accepts skipped and unsure.

AttorneyReferralIn.title: AttorneyReferralIn
AttorneyReferralIn.description: UC-CASE-16. Something Cairn should not guide alone. The journey is never blocked by it.

user_role.title: User Role
user_role.description: The same answer as a case creation user_role. Send it to POST /v1/cases so the question is not asked again.

status.title: Status
status.description: read_only when the case is active and the account's free period has ended.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: What to call the person who died. Not a legal name.

draft_expires_at.title: Draft Expires At
draft_expires_at.description: Drafts only. Any activity moves it out again.

deceased.description: Only once a task has collected it.

CaseResponse.title: CaseResponse
CaseResponse.description: Opening a case. For a draft this is the resume turn (UC-CASE-10) and counts as activity.

deceased_name.title: Deceased Name
deceased_name.description: The display name from intake, or its fallback. Not a legal name.

document_version.title: Document Version
document_version.description: Send back when agreeing, to show which text was agreed to.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: How Cairn would reply in this voice.

ConfirmationIn.title: ConfirmationIn
ConfirmationIn.description: The proposals the user confirmed ("Did I get that right?"). Only data_fields keys are accepted.

DeathNotYetIn.title: DeathNotYetIn
DeathNotYetIn.description: UC-CASE-17. not_yet records that the person hasn't died. has_happened clears it.

DeceasedIdentityPatch.title: DeceasedIdentityPatch
DeceasedIdentityPatch.description:
Just-in-time identity, inside a task that needs it, once the journey has started.

Never part of case creation. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Null clears a field.

FieldKey.title: FieldKey
FieldKey.description: The spec's data_fields, in the order Cairn suggests them. There is no required order.

FirstTaskIn.title: FirstTaskIn
FirstTaskIn.description: UC-CASE-13. A task id, small_task, or not_today. Cairn never starts a task the user didn't choose.

complete_task.title: Complete Task
complete_task.description: Mark the task done after recording this notice.

InstitutionNoticeRequest.title: InstitutionNoticeRequest
InstitutionNoticeRequest.description: Record that an institution was told. Do not send account numbers. There is no field for them.

IntakeMessageIn.title: IntakeMessageIn
IntakeMessageIn.description: Free text from the user (UC-CASE-01 own words, and any chat turn). Never stored.

name_fallback.title: Name Fallback
name_fallback.description: UC-CASE-03. What to say when no display name was given.

ask_residence.title: Ask Residence
ask_residence.description: The user said the death happened away from home, so residence_state is asked (UC-CASE-04).

IntakeSession.title: IntakeSession
IntakeSession.description:
Per-session state the client keeps and sends back with each turn (UC-CASE-14).

The server never stores it. Decision 7 in database/CLAUDE.md: no inference
about the user's emotional state is persisted. Send back the session from
the last response. Omit it at the start of a new session.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Free-text readback. Nothing is saved until confirmed.

redactions.title: Redactions
redactions.description: Kinds of values removed, never the values.

masked_text.title: Masked Text
masked_text.description: The user's message with sensitive numbers removed. Replace the local copy with this.

IntakeTurnResponse.title: IntakeTurnResponse
IntakeTurnResponse.description: One conversational turn. Acknowledgment first, at most one question, exactly one next action.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: One or two sentences on why this journey fits.

pre_button_notice.description: Shown above the buttons. None when the journey can't start (the death hasn't happened).

next_step.description: Start journey and Not yet, or why it can't start.

JourneyPreviewResponse.title: JourneyPreviewResponse
JourneyPreviewResponse.description: UC-CASE-12. The journey that fits, before it starts. Nothing here starts the free period.

action.title: Action
action.description: Machine-readable step code the client routes on.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Plain-language text to show the user.

NextStep.title: NextStep
NextStep.description: The single next thing to ask or do. Clients render one question at a time.

source_urls.title: Source Urls
source_urls.description: Citations. Render next to the text.

attorney_line.title: Attorney Line
attorney_line.description: Shown with anything flagged for an attorney.

PauseRequest.title: PauseRequest
PauseRequest.description: No reason field, on purpose. Cairn does not store why someone stepped back.

status.description: done for completed_items, check_on_this when unsure, else not_started.

status_label.title: Status Label
status_label.description: Done, Check on this, or When you're ready. Text, never color alone.

label.title: Label
label.description: How the value reads back to the user.

pre_question.title: Pre Question
pre_question.description: Why Cairn asks. Shown before the question.

skip.description: Skip for now. On every question.

not_sure.description: I'm not sure. On every question.

ReadAloud.title: ReadAloud
ReadAloud.description: Every case creation screen offers Read this to me.

name_from_provider.title: Name From Provider
name_from_provider.description: A name Google or Apple shared at sign-in. Kept only to pre-fill the preferred name question. Apple sends it on the first sign-in only, so send it then.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: Used to show trial dates in local time.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The user's own words where free text was given, except circumstance.

later.title: Later
later.description: What we can figure out later

ai_provider.title: Ai Provider
ai_provider.description: Third-party AI provider, named before any data is sent to it.

Screen.title: Screen
Screen.description: What to render. One question per screen. The question itself is next_step.prompt.

auth0_connection.title: Auth0 Connection
auth0_connection.description: Pass as the connection parameter to Auth0's /authorize to skip the chooser and go straight to this method.

user_role.description: The answer from the onboarding hand-off (CaseHandoffResponse.user_role), so the question is not asked twice. Omit to ask it during intake.

pre_button_notice_version.title: Pre Button Notice Version
pre_button_notice_version.description: From JourneyPreviewResponse.pre_button_notice.version. Proves the notice was shown before Start journey was enabled.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.description: With the trial end date in the user's local time zone.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: The one or two most time-sensitive tasks.

next_step.description: What feels doable right now? Recommended, small task, Not today.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Journey notes attached to this task.

content_reviewed_by_counsel.title: Content Reviewed By Counsel
content_reviewed_by_counsel.description: False while the guidance is an unreviewed draft. Clients should label it as such.

TaskKind.title: TaskKind
TaskKind.description: Tasks with a structured completion record. Everything else is 'general'.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Journey notes attached to this task.

prefill.title: Prefill
prefill.description: Shared by Google or Apple. Show it for the user to confirm or change. Never save it without that.

Voice.title: Voice
Voice.description: How Cairn talks with the user (UC-REG-12). Tone only. Defined in voices/manifest.yaml.

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: A voice from the personality screen. choose_for_me selects the default voice, steady_direct.

methods.title: Methods
methods.description: Equally weighted. Show all three with the same emphasis.

HTTPBearer.description: Auth0 access token for the Cairn API audience.

tags.name: Registration
tags.description: UC-REG-01 to UC-REG-05. Welcome, sign-in, and account creation.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: UC-REG-07 to UC-REG-14. Acknowledgments, name, voice.

tags.name: Case creation
tags.description: UC-CASE-01 to UC-CASE-11 and UC-CASE-14 to UC-CASE-18. Drafts, intake answers, own words, review, and safety.

tags.name: Journey
tags.description: UC-CASE-12 and UC-CASE-13 (start the journey that fits), UC-12 and UC-13 (pausing and status).

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: UC-10, UC-11. Working through individual tasks.
